DESC: You can only have one Ally Workshop object placed at (or stored in) your C.A.M.P. at a time.
So remember: only your current Ally's quests will be available to you.
To access the quests of a different Ally, scrap the current Ally Workshop object placed at (or stored in) your C.A.M.P. You can then place the object for your new Ally and start playing their quests.
